To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the following four techniques are effective for constructing specification morphisms: 1. verifying a manually constructed specification morphism, 2. composing specification morphisms, 3. unskolemizing a specification axiom, and 4. connecting two specifications.

(1) The unskolemized and connection techniques provide a new, powerful approach to constructing specification morphisms; and (2) These techniques are applicable to the design of algorithms and data structures.

(a) specification morphisms can be constructed mechanically by applying unskolemization to the axioms of a specification, and (b) specification morphisms between two specifications can be constructed by composing specification morphisms between the two specifications and a third specification, and then using the unskolemization technique to construct the desired specification morphism.
